text:
Maya (Design): Dropping compact mocks for the rule list. Main questions: compact single-row with expand vs stacked cards, and should channel routing show inline badges or a collapsed "routing" pill? Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE

Omar (PM): Dense scanable rows preferred. Expand on click for details.

Liam (Eng): Compact rows win for perf. Stacked cards add too much DOM when customers have 100s of rules. Keep icons minimal.

Sasha (Accessibility): When expanding, don't move focus unexpectedly. Expose the expanded area as a region and add aria-live="polite" for the sample preview updates.

Priya (Product): Copy: 'suppress until' unclear. Recommend 'suppress notifications until' or 'mute channels until'. Also, a small volume indicator (low/med/high) would help triage.

Evan (Design): For routing, I'm leaning toward a "3 channels" pill that opens a popover with the list and toggles. Cleaner UI and fewer badges.

Liam (Eng): Popover is fine. Set aria-expanded on the pill, trap focus, and don't nest modals. We'll prototype keyboard behavior.

Sasha (Accessibility): Popover guidance: role=dialog, aria-modal=false, trap focus, Escape closes, return focus to pill. Add keyboard shortcut to jump to routing.

Maya (Design): Also proposing a hidden 'sample settings' chevron with a voice selector (Ops/On-call/Manager) so people can check notification wording. Keep it collapsed by default.

Priya (Product): Good idea. Keep it minimal by default. Ensure sample changes update aria-live.

Evan (Design): Mini-pill contrast: filled pills drop below AA. Use border-only mini-pills at small sizes. Also ellipsize long channel names and normalize emoji line-height.

Maya (Design): Plan: compact rows + click-to-expand, routing pill -> popover, hidden sample settings, bordered mini-pills. I'll post updated frames shortly.

Omar (PM): :thumbsup:

Sasha (Accessibility): +1, include the a11y notes in the spec.

Liam (Eng): +1, will build a perf-focused prototype.
